limited_hint: Calendar has no calendars configured on this Mac.
probe: set calCount to count of calendars
if calCount is 0 then return "limited|no calendars configured"

actions.description: Events starting within the next N days (default 1 = today), across all calendars: title, start, end, calendar, location.
script: set cname to name of c
set evs to (every event of c whose start date is greater than or equal to d1 and start date is less than d2)
set loc to location of e
if loc is missing value then set loc to ""
set out to out & (summary of e) & fsep & ((start date of e) as «class isot» as string) & fsep & ((end date of e) as «class isot» as string) & fsep & cname & fsep & loc & rsep
set out to out & (name of c) & rsep
